title: The Locked Greenhouse
narration: My neighbour's greenhouse light switched on whenever someone disappeared. Inside, jewellery from missing people hung from enormous flowers. Police found no bodies, only ordinary fertiliser and deliberate evidence, but human fragments clung to my shoes. I realised the soil came from my own garden. At home, my husband emptied another bag beneath our roses and watched officers search next door. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. He smiled and said the greenhouse had worked: everyone was digging in the wrong garden.
